title: Securing Hybrid Multicloud Environments
business: Organizations operating across both on-premises data centers and multiple public cloud providers.
problem: Fragmented security visibility leads to inconsistent policy enforcement and delayed detection of vulnerabilities across hybrid and multicloud resources.
solution: Microsoft Defender for Cloud provides unified cloud security posture management (CSPM) and workload protection (CWP) by centralizing security assessments and threat detection across hybrid and multicloud environments.
steps: Enable Microsoft Defender for Cloud in the Azure portal.
Connect non-Azure resources using Azure Arc to extend management capabilities.
Review the Secure Score to identify misconfigurations and prioritize remediation tasks.
Enable workload protection plans for specific resource types like servers or containers.
Monitor security alerts and compliance status from the centralized dashboard.
outcome: Improved security posture through consistent policy application and reduced risk exposure across the entire hybrid infrastructure.
limitation: The depth of security insights depends on the agent installation or API connectivity for non-Azure resources; check the 'Inventory' or 'Environment settings' blade to verify if resources are correctly onboarded and reporting data.
